verdict.rationale: SigNoz's official MCP server gives external agents like Claude, Cursor and Copilot natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces and alerts. Its Agent Skills let AI assistants generate queries over traces, logs and metrics and write ClickHouse queries, and the AI use-case docs list dashboard creation from natural language. All of this depends on bringing your own external AI agent rather than a built-in assistant. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language query or chart assistant, detail on how the generated queries and charts look, independent or hands-on corroboration that NL-to-query works well.
